page.layout: One page of text, with margin notes on the right. Above the text: running head "IOHANNES RAINOLDVS" and the heading "Christiano lectori." Text in two paragraphs, with a decorative initial H at the start. Marginal notes in the right margin beside lines 1 (a), 3 (b), and the lines with c, d and e. No notes in the left margin. Printed signature "Pp" at the foot.

main_text.head: Christiano lectori.
main_text.p: HABES, Christiane lector, aliquam operis instituti partem; minorem quidem multo, quàm & cupiebam, & tempus, ex quo publicarum prælectionum laboribus liberatus sum, exigere videbatur: sed quantulam per crebras infirmitates, ac insperatam ea causa diutinamque absentiam ab instrumentis ad incudem illam necessariis, elimare potui. Quanquam elimatam neque hanc partem, quam habes, possum dicere: adeò recentem, vel calentem potiùs ab incude, habes. Quo nomine verendum est, ne, qui limæ laborem & moram in theologis perinde ac {a}HoratiusDe arte poet. in poetis, requirunt, ejus præceptum in mentem Pontificiis merito adversum me venturum putent: vos ô Pompilius sanguis carmen reprehendite, quod non {*}Multa dies & multa litura coercuit.

Nam tametsi multa litura castigare studui, quæ scripsi; admonitionis {b}Horatianæ memor,Satyr. lib. 1. sat. 10. Sæpe stylum vertas, iterum quæ digna legi sint, Scripturus: editionem tamen operis in nonum annum non distuli, nec tam multa die, quàm ipse suadet, corrigendas membranas intus posui. Verùm enimvero plus apud me valet sanctum exemplum {c}duorumLuc. 24. v. 13. in Evangelio celebrium discipulorum: qui, simul atque à Christo de resurrectione ipsius sunt instructi, nihil eo moti quòd {d}diei satis neutiquam habebant,ver. 29. {e}Ierosolymamver. 33. noctu ab Emmaunte, vico sexaginta stadiis dissito, reverterunt, ut veritatem ad alios quamprimum propagarent.

page.notes: The decorative initial is a woodcut "H", joined to "ABES" as "HABES". The reference mark before "Multa" is an unclear symbol, transcribed as {*}. The note "Luc. 24. v. 13." is printed with a small mark, and the number 13 is partly obscured. The word "elimare" is as printed, and "Ierosolymam" uses a plain s. The mark for note "a" is read as a superscript a, and the margin note is taken to belong to it.
